clips.title: The story
paras: In the Valley of Honor, Orgrimmar's warriors and hunters prepare for battle. Its barracks, guilds, and battlemasters serve the Horde's forces across Azeroth, while forges and training grounds keep its fighters ready.

The Valley of Honor holds Orgrimmar's military quarter behind high canyon ridges. Practice weapons clash, and blacksmiths' anvils ring through the day. The Hall of the Brave draws seasoned warriors and battlemasters who coordinate campaigns in places such as Alterac Valley and Warsong Gulch. Training grounds for beastmasters and hunters flank the hall. Across the valley, the Horde equips, drills, and sends out its frontline defenders.

The valley supplies arms and offers a place to rest between duties. The Burning Anvil and Red Canyon Mining provide armor and raw iron, while engineers work nearby in Nogg's Machine Shop. Grunts and visiting adventurers can fish in a quiet pool, taking a brief pause from the dust of the Valley of Strength.
